newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL TIN DOWN ON LME, STILL LOOKING AT 15 RGT/KG.
newsitem.headline: KL TIN DOWN ON LME, STILL LOOKING AT 15 RGT/KG.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price fell 19 cents to 14.67 ringgit ($5.29) a kg on Wednesday after tracking an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange, traders said.
They said the ringgit had also recovered slightly from its weakness against the dollar, prompting a correction in the price.
Traders said despite the fall, there were still prospects for the tin price to hit 15 ringgit a kg in the near-term.
"It could happen if the LME is firm over the next couple of days and the ringgit stays soft," said a trader.
At the opening, there were bids for 194 tonnes against a sales offer of 85 tonnes.
Final turnover was 103 tonnes, from 135 on Tuesday, and was absorbed by European, Japanese and local interests.
